title: Η Γυφτοπούλα
summary: "Η Γυφτοπούλα" by Alexandros Papadiamantes is a novel first published in serialized form from April to October 1884. Set during the final days of the Byzantine Empire before Constantinople's fall in 1453, the story follows a young woman raised by a Romani family near Mystras. She endures hardship and prejudice while desperately seeking to uncover the mystery of her true origins.
